title: Build a Swappable News Remote Source
prompt: Declare a Retrofit article API, implement status and DTO mapping in a remote source, wrap it in a repository, and verify requests through MockWebServer.
successCriteria: No Retrofit or DTO type reaches UI state.
Client instances are shared and injected.
Integration tests cover success, empty, error, malformed, and cancellation.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: interface NewsService { @GET("articles") suspend fun articles(): Response<ArticlePageDto> }

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
